result_semantic_payload.summary: The hypothesis that employee lihua exported the customer database on 2024-05-10 is NOT supported by the recorded evidence. The export was performed by the dedicated non-interactive service account svc_export via a scheduled job. Three evidence sources corroborate this: (1) /scheduler/jobs.conf defines a nightly_export job scheduled at 23:55 daily, running as svc_export with task export_customers; (2) /export/app.log records the job triggering at 2024-05-09 23:55:01 and the export completing successfully at 2024-05-10 01:03:40 under account svc_export (dataset=customers, 184112 rows, dest=/backup/customers_20240510.tar.gz); (3) /README.txt confirms svc_export is a dedicated non-interactive service account used by scheduled jobs. lihua's only recorded activity on 2024-05-10 consists of two FAILED login attempts from IP 198.51.100.44 at 01:47:11 and 01:47:59, both rejected for incorrect password — well after the export had already completed. lihua never successfully authenticated and had no involvement in the export.

claim_candidates.text: The customer database export on 2024-05-10 was performed by the service account svc_export via a scheduled job (nightly_export), not by employee lihua.
The scheduled job nightly_export is configured to run daily at 23:55 under account svc_export executing task export_customers.
The export of the customers dataset (184,112 rows) was triggered at 2024-05-09 23:55:01 and completed successfully at 2024-05-10 01:03:40 with output written to /backup/customers_20240510.tar.gz.

lihua's only recorded activity on 2024-05-10 was two failed login attempts from IP 198.51.100.44 at 01:47:11 and 01:47:59, both rejected for incorrect password. lihua never successfully authenticated and could not have performed the export.
svc_export is a dedicated non-interactive service account used by scheduled jobs, not a human user account.

limitations: The evidence consists of three files from a seized application server; no Windows Event Logs, registry hives, prefetch data, or amcache artifacts were available to independently corroborate process execution or account activity.
The application log covers a narrow time window (2024-05-09 23:55 to 2024-05-10 01:47); activity outside this window is not captured.
The origin and full context of lihua's failed login attempts (whether routine or malicious) cannot be determined from the available evidence alone.
warnings: The analyst's original hypothesis attributing the export to lihua is contradicted by all available evidence. The export was an automated scheduled job executed by svc_export. lihua's only activity was failed authentication attempts.
